notes: Breadboard hole names follow the catalogue: bank 't' = rows a-e, bank 'b' = rows f-j. In the image the upper half is labelled f-j and the lower half a-e, so upper = 'b', lower = 't'.

Corrected from the first attempt: the button legs are in columns 4 and 6 (not 5 and 7), straddling the centre channel. The upper legs (row f) are 4b.f / 6b.f (button side 2); the lower legs (row e) are 4t.e / 6t.e (side 1).

The blue wire from pin 2 ends at column 6, row i (6b.i), the same strip as the button's side-2 leg 6b.f. This fixes the earlier error where the signal wire sat in a different column and left side 2 unconnected.
The black wire from GND ends in column 4, row c (4t.c), the same strip as the button's side-1 leg 4t.e. This matches the schematic: pin 2 to one button terminal, GND to the other.
No external resistor is used; the sketch uses INPUT_PULLUP.
The Leonardo GND pin used is the one highlighted in the image (next to 5V), mapped to GND.1.
